spec.concept: A review that reports each finding with its severity, root cause and recommended fix
spec.scene: Clean brand card on a deep navy background with a single amber accent line beneath the headline text, minimal layout with generous spacing and white text, no icons or figures
spec.overlay_text: its severity, its root cause and a recommended fix
spec.alt_text: Navy card with white text reading: its severity, its root cause and a recommended fix, with an amber accent line beneath.

spec.concept: Credibility through completed work: a calm brand card noting Sentinel Grove's audit count and an invitation to request a review.
spec.scene: Minimal navy background with a thin amber line under the headline text, ample whitespace, and a simple abstract shield-and-grove motif in white outline at the lower right.
spec.alt_text: Navy brand card with white text reading completed 12 smart contract audits, underlined by a thin amber line.

spec.concept: Missing caller checks on withdrawal functions let anyone drain Ether; restrict withdrawals to authorized parties.
spec.scene: Dark navy background with a simple vault outline whose door is ajar, a single amber key-shaped accent beside it, and large clean space for the overlay text in white.
spec.alt_text: Navy brand card showing an open vault with an amber key and the text: Limit withdrawals to authorized parties.

spec.concept: Reentrancy: external calls can reenter before state is finalized, so state must be updated before the call.
spec.scene: Dark navy background with a simple diagram: a contract box handing control to a second box via an arrow, with a looping amber arrow returning to the first box before a storage cell is cleared. Clean, calm, technical layout with generous space for the overlay text.
spec.overlay_text: State updates after untrusted calls allow repeated execution
spec.alt_text: Diagram of one contract calling another, with an arrow looping back to the first contract before its stored balance is cleared, illustrating reentrancy.

spec.concept: Two variables share one name: shadowed state variables in inherited Solidity contracts lead to ambiguity about which one is read.
spec.scene: Two stacked contract blocks labeled A and B on a deep navy background, each holding a box named x. Thin amber lines connect each box to a separate code reader, showing one name resolving to two separate variables. Minimal, calm, technical layout with generous space for overlay text.
spec.alt_text: Diagram of two contract blocks, A and B, each containing its own variable named x, with separate amber lines showing that each contract reads a different copy.

spec.concept: An oracle is a trust boundary: price inputs that attackers can move
spec.scene: Technical diagram style card on a deep navy background. A simple price feed line enters a contract box through a dashed boundary line, with one spike in the line highlighted in amber. Clean geometric shapes, generous empty space for the overlay text, no extra words in the artwork.
spec.overlay_text: An oracle is a trust boundary
spec.alt_text: Diagram of a price feed line with one amber spike crossing a dashed trust boundary into a contract box, on a navy background.
